title: Clause Linkers and Paragraph Cohesion
lede: Move from sentence linking to paragraph architecture: introduce beliefs, exceptions, topic shifts, place clauses, time clauses and cohesive consequences.

items.prompt: Complete: أَعْتَقِدُ ___ التَّعَلُّمَ مُهِمٌّ.
items.feedback: أنّ introduces the content of the belief.

items.prompt: Choose a topic-shift frame.
items.feedback: أمّا introduces a topic and فـ introduces the comment.

items.prompt: Choose “after I finished”.
items.feedback: بعدما introduces a completed earlier action.

items.prompt: Choose formal “before I leave”.
items.feedback: Miftah uses قبل أن as the formal MSA house form.

items.prompt: Choose “since I began studying”.
items.feedback: منذ أن introduces a starting clause.

items.prompt: Do less common connectors earn automatic marks?
options: No; range and accuracy are judged in the whole response.
Yes; each rare connector guarantees one mark.
Only if written in English too.
items.feedback: Assessment rewards well-linked sentences and controlled range, not a connector checklist.

items.prompt: I believe that sport is important.
items.feedback: أنّ introduces the content of the belief.

items.prompt: It is clear that prices increased.
items.feedback: من الواضح أن is a useful formal frame.

items.prompt: Which follows أنَّ in this pattern?
items.feedback: أنّ connects the reporting frame to its content.

items.prompt: Choose the supported form.
items.feedback: أنّ makes its subject accusative in a fully marked model.

items.prompt: As for online learning, it is flexible.
options: أَمَّا التَّعَلُّمُ عَنْ بُعْدٍ فَهُوَ مَرِنٌ.
items.feedback: أمّا…فـ organises a topic and comment.

items.prompt: I live where services are available.
items.feedback: حيث = where/in the place where.

items.prompt: I eat all fruit except bananas.
items.feedback: إلا introduces the exception.

items.prompt: I prefer the city, whereas my brother prefers the countryside.
options: أُفَضِّلُ الْمَدِينَةَ، بَيْنَمَا يُفَضِّلُ أَخِي الرِّيفَ.
أُفَضِّلُ الْمَدِينَةَ حَيْثُ يُفَضِّلُ أَخِي الرِّيفَ.

items.prompt: Check the answer before you submit it.
items.feedback: قبل أن introduces the action not yet completed.

options: تَحَسَّنَتْ عَرَبِيَّتِي مُنْذُ أَنْ بَدَأْتُ التَّدَرُّبَ.
items.feedback: منذ أن links the present result to its starting event.

items.prompt: Formal Miftah house form for “before I leave”.
items.feedback: قبل أن + subjunctive is the formal target.

items.feedback: أنّ introduces the content.

items.feedback: أمّا pairs with فـ.

items.feedback: حيث introduces a place clause.

items.feedback: إلا = except.

options: قَبْلَ مَا أُسَافِرُ as house form

items.feedback: بعدما introduces the completed earlier action.

items.feedback: منذ أن marks a starting event.

items.feedback: بينما is the clearer contrast linker.

options: Does each connector express the relationship I intend?

games.e: Assessment is holistic within the published descriptors.

blocks: ## Why this matters
Paragraph cohesion lets a reader follow the writer’s thinking across sentences. Advanced-looking linkers help only when they are structurally and logically accurate.
### Core
Use أعتقد أنَّ, بعدما, قبل أن and منذ أن.
### Develop
Use أمّا…فـ, حيث and إلا accurately.
### Stretch
Combine contrast, concession and topic organisation across a paragraph.

[callout] Cambridge link: The 2028 specimen Paper 4 mark scheme rewards a range of simple connectors in the shorter task and extended, well-linked sentences with varied structures in the longer task. It does not allocate automatic marks for named “advanced” linkers.
## Diagnostic start
Select the structure that matches the function and formal register.
## Content clauses with أَنَّ
أنَّ lets a verb of thinking, believing, knowing or saying carry a complete idea.

TABLE: Frame | Model | Meaning // أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ | أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ التَّعَلُّمَ عَنْ بُعْدٍ مُفِيدٌ. | I think that… // أَظُنُّ أَنَّ | أَظُنُّ أَنَّ الطَّقْسَ سَيَتَحَسَّنُ. | I think/suppose that… // أَعْرِفُ أَنَّ | أَعْرِفُ أَنَّ الِامْتِحَانَ صَعْبٌ. | I know that… // قَالَ إِنَّ / ذَكَرَ أَنَّ | ذَكَرَ الْكَاتِبُ أَنَّ التِّقْنِيَّةَ مُهِمَّةٌ. | The writer stated that… // مِنَ الْوَاضِحِ أَنَّ | مِنَ الْوَاضِحِ أَنَّ الْخِدْمَةَ تَحَسَّنَتْ. | It is clear that…
[callout] Supported case awareness: In fully marked models, the subject after أَنَّ is accusative: أَنَّ الطَّقْسَ , أَنَّ الدِّرَاسَةَ . Full إنّ-family analysis belongs in Nominal Sentences.
## Specific links: أَمَّا…فَـ، حَيْثُ، إِلَّا
These connectors are not interchangeable; each has a distinct discourse job.

TABLE: Structure | Function | Model // أَمَّا…فَـ | introduce a topic, then comment | أَمَّا الْقِطَارُ فَهُوَ أَسْرَعُ. // حَيْثُ | where / in the place where | أُفَضِّلُ السَّكَنَ حَيْثُ تُوجَدُ الْخِدْمَاتُ. // إِلَّا | except / excluding | أُحِبُّ كُلَّ الْمَوَادِّ إِلَّا الرِّيَاضِيَّاتِ. // بَيْنَمَا | while / whereas; contrast or simultaneous action | أُفَضِّلُ الْمَدِينَةَ، بَيْنَمَا يُفَضِّلُ أَخِي الرِّيفَ.

[callout/warning] Translation correction: حَيْثُ primarily means “where / in the place where” in this lesson. Do not use it mechanically for English “whereas”; بَيْنَمَا is the clearer contrast linker.
[callout] أَمَّا…فَـ is a pair: Do not leave the second half without فَـ : أَمَّا الْبَيْتُ فَهُوَ وَاسِعٌ .
## Time clauses: after, before and since
A time linker relates one action to another, not merely to a time noun.

TABLE: Structure | Core use | Model // بَعْدَمَا + past | after an action was completed | بَعْدَمَا أَنْهَيْتُ وَاجِبِي، خَرَجْتُ. // بَعْدَ أَنْ + verb | after doing / after an action | خَرَجْتُ بَعْدَ أَنْ أَنْهَيْتُ وَاجِبِي. // قَبْلَ أَنْ + subjunctive | before doing / before an action | رَاجِعْ عَمَلَكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُسَلِّمَهُ. // مُنْذُ + noun | since a point / for a period | أَعْمَلُ هُنَا مُنْذُ عَامٍ. // مُنْذُ أَنْ + past | since an action began/happened | تَحَسَّنَتْ لُغَتِي مُنْذُ أَنْ بَدَأْتُ التَّدَرُّبَ.
[callout] House form: The syllabus lists forms such as “بعد ما / قبل ما”. Miftah uses standard written MSA بَعْدَمَا or بَعْدَ أَنْ , and قَبْلَ أَنْ for formal examination writing.
[callout/warning] Subjunctive link: After قَبْلَ أَنْ , the present verb is subjunctive: قَبْلَ أَنْ أَذْهَبَ , not أَذْهَبُ in a fully marked model.
## Build a cohesive paragraph
Plan the relationship between sentences before selecting linkers.

[ar] أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ السَّفَرَ مُفِيدٌ لِأَنَّهُ يُعَرِّفُنَا بِثَقَافَاتٍ جَدِيدَةٍ. أَمَّا السَّفَرُ بِالطَّائِرَةِ فَهُوَ سَرِيعٌ، وَلَكِنَّهُ مُكْلِفٌ. لِذَلِكَ أُفَضِّلُ الْقِطَارَ عِنْدَمَا يَكُونُ ذَلِكَ مُمْكِنًا.
[ar] بَعْدَمَا وَصَلْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ، ذَهَبْنَا إِلَى الْفُنْدُقِ. ثُمَّ خَرَجْنَا حَيْثُ تُوجَدُ الْمَطَاعِمُ الشَّهِيرَةُ.

[callout] Paper 4 principle: The longer writing task rewards extended, well-linked sentences and a range of structures used appropriately. One accurate complex sentence is stronger evidence than several memorised linkers placed unnaturally.

TABLE: Paragraph job | Useful signals // state view | أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ، مِنْ وَجْهَةِ نَظَرِي // give reason | لِأَنَّ، بِسَبَبِ // contrast / balance | لَكِنْ، بَيْنَمَا، عَلَى الرَّغْمِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ // add a developed point | بِالْإِضَافَةِ إِلَى ذَلِكَ، عِلَاوَةً عَلَى ذَلِكَ // show result | لِذَلِكَ، لِذَا، وَمِنْ ثَمَّ // organise topic | أَمَّا…فَـ، مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ… وَمِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ أُخْرَى // sequence events | بَعْدَمَا، قَبْلَ أَنْ، ثُمَّ، أَخِيرًا
## Misconception and proofreading clinic
Remove automatic, colloquial or structurally incomplete links.

TABLE: Weak / inaccurate | Improved | Reason // أَعْتَقِدُ لِأَنَّ التَّعَلُّمُ مُهِمٌّ. | أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ التَّعَلُّمَ مُهِمٌّ. | belief content uses أنَّ // أَمَّا الْقِطَارُ هُوَ سَرِيعٌ. | أَمَّا الْقِطَارُ فَهُوَ سَرِيعٌ. | أمّا pairs with فـ // أُفَضِّلُ الْمَدِينَةَ حَيْثُ أَخِي يُفَضِّلُ الرِّيفَ. | أُفَضِّلُ الْمَدِينَةَ، بَيْنَمَا يُفَضِّلُ أَخِي الرِّيفَ. | contrast is بينما, not حيث // قَبْلَ مَا أَذْهَبُ في formal exam model | قَبْلَ أَنْ أَذْهَبَ | formal MSA house form // استخدمت لذلك لأن لذلك… | Choose one accurate cause/result chain. | more linkers do not automatically mean more range
## Grammar game
Choose the clause linker that makes the paragraph relationship precise.
## Skills workshop التَّطْبِيقُ الْعَمَلِيُّ
Read cohesion signals, reconstruct a paragraph and produce an extended well-linked response.
[ar] وَ وَ وَ وَ…
[ar] أَوَّلًا… ثُمَّ… لِأَنَّ… لِذَلِكَ… أَمَّا… فَـ… وَلَكِنْ…
### Write an extended cohesive response
Write 130–140 Arabic words on one topic: online learning, transport, holidays, technology or the environment. Organise the response into a clear sequence of ideas rather than a list of sentences.
[callout] Success checklist: Include أعتقد أنَّ; one reason and result chain; one أمّا…فـ topic shift; one contrast; one time clause with بعدما/قبل أن/منذ أن; one precise prepositional phrase.
[callout] Paper route: Plan five paragraph jobs in the margin. After writing, label each connector by function and replace any repeated or illogical link.
## Final mastery check
Check content clauses, exceptions, topic shifts, time links and paragraph organisation.
### What you can now do
- Use أَنَّ after high-frequency verbs of thought and reporting.
- Use أَمَّا…فَـ, حَيْثُ and إِلَّا for specific discourse functions.
- Build formal time links with بَعْدَمَا/بَعْدَ أَنْ, قَبْلَ أَنْ and مُنْذُ أَنْ.
- Edit a paragraph for logical, accurate and varied cohesion.
Spaced revisit: Return in two or three days and complete the final check again without looking at the tables.
